scripts.prebuild: node -e "const{execSync}=require('child_process');const h=execSync('git log -1 --format=%h').toString().trim();const d=execSync('git log -1 --format=%aI').toString().trim();const fs=require('fs');let c=fs.readFileSync('src/engine.ts','utf8');c=c.replace(/const GIT_HASH = '.*?'/,`const GIT_HASH = '${h}'`).replace(/const GIT_DATE = '.*?'/,`const GIT_DATE = '${d}'`);fs.writeFileSync('src/engine.ts',c)"
scripts.build: npm run prebuild && tsc && vite build
